scripts.podman:build: varlock run --path ./deploy/ -- podman compose -f container/compose.production.yml build
scripts.podman:down: varlock run --path ./deploy/ -- podman compose -f container/compose.production.yml down
scripts.podman:logs: varlock run --path ./deploy/ -- podman compose -f container/compose.production.yml logs -f
scripts.env:generate: varlock codegen --path ./apps/web/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/server/ && varlock codegen --path ./packages/db/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/worker/
scripts.postinstall: varlock codegen --path ./apps/web/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/server/ && varlock codegen --path ./packages/db/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/worker/
scripts.infra:up: podman compose -f container/compose.yml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 120 postgres redis
scripts.infra:down: podman compose -f container/compose.yml stop postgres redis
scripts.telemetry:up: podman compose -f container/compose.yml -f container/compose.observability.yml up -d otel-collector
scripts.telemetry:down: podman compose -f container/compose.yml -f container/compose.observability.yml stop otel-collector
